facts.heading: Divorce after 15 years of marriage
facts.content: Jana and her husband decided to get a divorce after 15 years of marriage.
facts.evidence: After 15 years of marriage, my husband and I decided to get a divorce.

facts.heading: Husband's decision date
facts.content: Jana's husband told her the divorce would not go any further in September.
facts.evidence: And in September he told me that it was not going any further.

facts.heading: Jana's emotional reaction to divorce
facts.content: Jana experienced feelings of emptiness and anger several times a day after the divorce decision.
facts.evidence: Emptiness. Then anger. Then emptiness again.

facts.heading: Husband's affair details
facts.content: Jana's husband, Vladez Znobirin, was having an affair with Radek, who lives next door.
facts.evidence: He says we were together, that we live next to each other.

facts.heading: Jana's perception of her blindness
facts.content: Jana feels she should have noticed the signs of the affair.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I was blind.

facts.heading: Jana's current state of mind
facts.content: Jana keeps thinking about the affair and looking for mistakes.
facts.evidence: I keep thinking about it and I keep looking for mistakes.

facts.heading: Jana's perceived limitations
facts.content: Jana believes she was too tired and too old to notice the affair.
facts.evidence: I think I was too tired and I wasn't interested in them.

facts.heading: Jana's children's names and age
facts.content: Jana has two children named Anšce and Matěj, and they are 8 years old.
facts.evidence: I have two kids, Anšce and Matěj. They are 8 years old.

facts.heading: Decision to tell children about divorce
facts.content: Jana and her husband, Radek, want to tell the children about the divorce together, but they keep postponing it.
facts.evidence: Radek wants us to tell them together. But we keep postponing it.

facts.heading: Anšce's suspicion about dating
facts.content: Last week, Anšce asked Jana if they were dating.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if we were dating.

facts.heading: Jana's feeling about Anšce's lie
facts.content: Jana felt terrible because she believes Anšce lied to her.
facts.evidence: I felt terrible. Because she lied to me.

facts.heading: Anšce's perceived lie content
facts.content: Jana believes Anšce lied about Jana destroying her life and taking her home.
facts.evidence: That I destroy her life. That I take her home.

facts.heading: Jana's fear regarding telling truth
facts.content: Jana is afraid of her children's tears when she tells them the truth.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid of their tears.

facts.heading: Jana's work as Czech teacher
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno.

facts.heading: Jana's teaching grades
facts.content: Jana teaches 9th and 8th grade.
facts.evidence: I teach 9th and 8th grade.

facts.heading: Jana's current activity
facts.content: Jana walks around with a rabbit in her hand.
facts.evidence: I walk around with a rabbit in my hand.

facts.heading: Principal knows about life issues
facts.content: Jana told the principal about her life falling apart.
facts.evidence: Only the principal.

facts.heading: Principal allowed early departure
facts.content: The principal allowed Jana to leave school an hour early after Jana cried on the court.
facts.evidence: She gave me an hour off.

facts.heading: Worse when alone at work
facts.content: Jana felt it was worse when she was alone at work because she had something to do.
facts.evidence: Because I was alone at work. I had at least something to do.

facts.heading: Waking up at 3am nightly
facts.content: Jana wakes up at 3 am every night and thinks about what is next.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at 3am and I think about what's next.

facts.heading: Feeling of lacking possessions
facts.content: Jana stated she does not have a mortgage, a wife, or anything.
facts.evidence: I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a wife, I don't have anything.

facts.heading: Counting money, imagining telling kids
facts.content: Jana counts money and imagines how she would tell her kids.
facts.evidence: I count the money, I imagine how I tell my kids.

facts.heading: Sleep schedule
facts.content: Jana sleeps around 5 am and wakes up at 7:30 am.
facts.evidence: I sleep around 5 and wake up at half past 7.

facts.heading: Weight loss
facts.content: Jana has lost 4 kilos and does not move much.
facts.evidence: I lost 4 kilos.

facts.heading: Sister in Olomouc calls nightly
facts.content: Jana has a sister in Olomouc who calls her almost every evening.
facts.evidence: I have a sister in Olomouc. She calls me almost every evening

facts.heading: Friend from Eva's calls
facts.content: Jana has a friend of Eva's from work she can talk to.
facts.evidence: a friend of Eva's from work.

facts.heading: Friend's comment on Jana's marriage
facts.content: Eva's friend told Jana that a woman who can't hold a marriage isn't a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That a woman who can't hold a marriage isn't a good example for children.

facts.heading: Mother's belief on marriage
facts.content: Jana believes her mom always said that marriage is held and it's up to her.
facts.evidence: She always said that marriage is held and it's up to you.

facts.heading: Mother's reaction to Jana
facts.content: Jana's mom was sad when Jana told her and said she hopes Jana has been good to her.
facts.evidence: She was sad. Then she said that she hopes I've been good to her.

facts.heading: Jana feels sadness
facts.content: Jana feels sad and believes she would need to be praised.
facts.evidence: Sad. She would need to praise me.

facts.heading: Jana's desire to tell mother
facts.content: Jana wants to tell her mom that it hurts and that she doesn't want to be alone.
facts.evidence: That it hurts, that I don't want to be alone

facts.heading: Jana cries when speaking out
facts.content: Jana cries when she says her feelings out loud.
facts.evidence: I'm crying.

facts.heading: Jana drinks tea for sleep
facts.content: Jana drinks tea to help with sleep.
facts.evidence: I drink tea, that's all.

facts.heading: Fear of addiction/missing kids
facts.content: Jana is afraid of becoming addicted to medication and missing her kids.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I wouldn't wake up in time for the kids and I don't want to be addicted.

facts.heading: Fear of panicking and crying
facts.content: Jana is afraid that she will panic and cry.
facts.evidence: That I panic and cry.

facts.heading: Fear of being a coward
facts.content: Jana finds the idea of being a coward scary.
facts.evidence: That would be scary for me.

facts.heading: Desire for others to accept
facts.content: Jana wishes others would see that they are allowed to do something.
facts.evidence: Or maybe they could see that we're allowed to do so.

facts.heading: Feeling of not being alone
facts.content: Jana feels better knowing she is not alone.
facts.evidence: That I'm not alone

facts.heading: No immediate pressure to act
facts.content: Jana feels she does not have to do something right away.
facts.evidence: and that I don't have to do it right away.
